messages:
alex (newhire): hey everyone, first day! i accepted the GitHub org invite but nothing shows up under my organizations. when i click the invite link it says "invite expired" and the GH web UI then asks me to enable SAML/SSO and 2FA. i tried to enable 2FA but it wants backup codes i never had. who should i ping to finish setup?
it-support: welcome alex! usually this is either an expired invite or a mismatched email/gh account. what email did you accept with and what's your github username? we enforce SAML SSO + 2FA. if the invite expired we can resend; if you already have another GH account logged in your browser that can cause 404s.
alex (newhire): accepted with alex.codes@protonmail.com and my username is alexcodes. i only have auth app on my phone but no backup codes, so had trouble completing the flow.
devex: hey alex 100 congrats and welcome :tada: two quick tips: 1) open the invite in an incognito window or sign out of other GH accounts, 2) you can set up 2FA (TOTP) then generate new recovery codes on the account settings page. if the invite link is stale we will re-issue. also we have a small gh-cli helper: `gh auth login` then accept via the link in email while logged into the right account.
it-support: resending invite now. note: if you use multiple GH accounts, accept the invite while signed into the account that matches alex.codes@protonmail.com. if you keep seeing SAML prompts click "Connect to SSO" which will redirect you and then require 2FA. let us know the exact error if it persists.
onboard-bot: Automated checklist: 1) Accept org invite 2) Connect SSO 3) Enable 2FA + save backup codes 4) Add SSH key -> https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/git
ben: @alexcodes once you are a member we'll add you to the engineering team with read+PR by default. infra and private repos are gated behind a short security review. if you think you need push directly, say so and include why.
sophie (manager): cc @sam (security) once basic access is done i can approve infra access for alex to follow up on CI debugging.
alex (newhire): invite email arrived, accepted in incognito, enabled TOTP with Authy and saved the recovery codes. connected SSO and i can see the org now. thanks!
ben: added to team "engineering" with repo access for public repos. infra access pending security review.
sam (security): quick note: for infra repos we need a one-line justification and manager approval. sophie please reply in this thread and i will add alex to infra-readers.
sophie (manager): approving infra read access for alex for first-week ramp.
sam (security): added alex to infra-readers (read-only) and allowed access to ci-logs. elevated push rights can be requested after training: https://redwood.example.com/security-training
alex (newhire): can clone `git@github.com:redwood-inference/runtime.git` and opened a tiny doc fix PR. everything seems to work now 44d
it-support: glad it's resolved. closing this thread 4cc if anything else pops up ping #help or DM us.
